title: Read the tyre DOT date before buying
hook: Read this 4-digit code before you buy tyres
youtube_title: How to check tyre manufacturing date (DOT code) before buying

slides.heading: Read this 4-digit code before you buy tyres

voice_lines: Look for a four digit code on the tyre's sidewall. The first two digits are the week, the last two are the year.
So two three two five means the twenty third week of twenty twenty five.
When buying new tyres, ask for ones made within the last year, not stock that's been sitting for years.
Rubber ages even when unused. Replace at the tread wear bars, or sooner if you see cracks. Any doubts? Comment below or DM me on Instagram.
caption:
Before you buy tyres, read this 4-digit code on the sidewall 🛞

First 2 digits = week, last 2 = year. Example: 2325 = 23rd week of 2025.

✅ Buy tyres made within the last year
❌ Avoid stock that's been sitting for years

Rubber ages even unused. Replace at the tread wear bars, or sooner if you see cracks.

Any doubts? Comment below or DM me on Instagram 👇
